name: polkadot
description: Fork-only, bitten on the fly (no sudo, so a runtime under test must be injected at bite time rather than upgraded afterwards). Relay, Asset Hub, People and Bulletin — the system chains the fellowship's Individuality release (runtimes 2.5) lands on.

bite._note: No sudo: a runtime upgrade is authorized at import instead of dispatched. `ppn bite --upgrade asset-hub=<wasm>` seeds System::AuthorizedUpgrade, and `ppn runtime-upgrade` submits the apply half unsigned. Belongs in zombie-bite (paritytech/zombie-bite#127) once PPN calls it instead of driving doppelganger. v0.2.3 is the first doppelganger honouring ZOMBIE_WARP_SKIP_PROOF, without which the state sync stalls partway through and never recovers.

parachains._dotnsNote: DotnsPopController, the contract pallet-dotns-gateway dispatches into. Every dotNS address is CREATE3(factory, keccak('dotns.create3.v1:<label>:<kind>')) and the factory is CREATE(deployer, nonce 0), so one key fixes the whole set and every address is computable before anything is deployed. This is the address dotns records for paseo-assethub, which previewnet and paseo-next-v2 share, so a client with those addresses hardcoded finds this deployment too. dotnsDeployer lists the factory key first, 0xd498F7BC, which dotns CI names FACTORY_DEPLOYER and whose nonce must be 0 here or the factory lands elsewhere and takes the whole set with it; the second signs the pipeline and becomes the proxy owner. Which contract belongs here follows the dotns release: one still carrying RootGatewayDispatcher wants that instead, at 0xa889CCA3Fb4B07b98a11cc54C10f13dDA20bc3db, which is not a CREATE3 address and so cannot be reproduced from any key. config/versions.env pins DOTNS_TAG at a release that still ships it, so the genesis networks are on the other side of that boundary. Deploy with EXPECTED_CREATE3_FACTORY=0x8533c79E058c5a6489CAFeCA86dc600E029D75f5 so a wrong key aborts rather than silently relocating the protocol away from the address seeded here.
parachains._note: A public system chain carries its spec inside the parachain binary, so unlike Paseo's Asset Hub it needs no host to publish one. Its Aura keys are ed25519, alone among the system chains: with the sr25519 default the collator matches no slot and authors nothing, without ever reporting an error.
Not built into polkadot-parachain; Parity's own bulletin RPC nodes run from this published spec (devops-cloud-infra, values-parity-chains-polkadot-bulletin-rpc.yaml).
